# chalk_managed_gcp_vpc (Resource)

Chalk managed GCP VPC resource. Creates a fully managed VPC using the provided cloud credentials.

**Required permissions:** `team.admin` *(team-scoped)*, `project.create` *(team-scoped)*



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_credential_id` (String) ID of the cloud credential to use for the managed VPC
- `subnets` (Attributes List) Primary subnets provisioned in the VPC. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnets))

### Optional

- `backup_subnets` (Attributes List) Backup subnets, created after the primary subnets. A `REGIONAL_MANAGED_PROXY` subnet's BACKUP peer must be created after its ACTIVE peer. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--backup_subnets))
- `vpc_peer_addr` (String) Address used for the internal range reserved for private service access (VPC peering with servicenetworking.googleapis.com). Unset lets GCP pick; the GCP-picked address is not reported back, so an unset value stays null in state.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) VPC identifier

<a id="nestedatt--subnets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subnets`

Required:

- `cidr_range` (String) Primary IPv4 CIDR range for the subnet.
- `name` (String) Subnet name.
- `purpose` (String) Subnet purpose, e.g. `PRIVATE` or `REGIONAL_MANAGED_PROXY`.

Optional:

- `role` (String) Subnet role for `REGIONAL_MANAGED_PROXY` subnets: `ACTIVE` or `BACKUP`. Leave unset for `PRIVATE` subnets.
- `secondary_ip_ranges` (Attributes List) Secondary IP ranges (alias ranges) for the subnet, e.g. for GKE pods/services. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnets--secondary_ip_ranges))

<a id="nestedatt--subnets--secondary_ip_ranges"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subnets.secondary_ip_ranges`

Required:

- `ip_cidr_range` (String) CIDR range for the secondary range.
- `range_name` (String) Name of the secondary range.



<a id="nestedatt--backup_subnets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `backup_subnets`

Required:

- `cidr_range` (String) Primary IPv4 CIDR range for the subnet.
- `name` (String) Subnet name.
- `purpose` (String) Subnet purpose, e.g. `PRIVATE` or `REGIONAL_MANAGED_PROXY`.

Optional:

- `role` (String) Subnet role. Defaults to `BACKUP` when unset.
- `secondary_ip_ranges` (Attributes List) Secondary IP ranges (alias ranges) for the subnet, e.g. for GKE pods/services. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--backup_subnets--secondary_ip_ranges))

<a id="nestedatt--backup_subnets--secondary_ip_ranges"></a>
### Nested Schema for `backup_subnets.secondary_ip_ranges`

Required:

- `ip_cidr_range` (String) CIDR range for the secondary range.
- `range_name` (String) Name of the secondary range.
